test_check_non_ascii_credential: test the hermes_cli.config._check_non_ascii_credential function to detect and strip non-ASCII characters from API keys
test_sanitize_loaded_credentials: test the hermes_cli.env_loader._sanitize_loaded_credentials function to strip non-ASCII characters from loaded environment credential variables
test_ascii_key_unchanged: test that _check_non_ascii_credential returns ASCII-only keys unchanged without printing warnings
test_strips_unicode_lookalike: test that _check_non_ascii_credential strips Unicode lookalike characters like U+028B from credential values and prints a warning
test_ignores_non_credential_vars: test that _sanitize_loaded_credentials leaves non-credential environment variables with Unicode characters untouched
